description: Whether a participant ("me") may Revise the turn at "target" in a history of "turns": one table for the server's rule (ParticipantRevise.refusal, spec/participant_revise_spec.rb) and the page's mirror (participant_revise.js mayReviseOwn, spec/web/public/participant_revise.test.js). A turn is {"by": me | owner | other | wake | shell, "answered" (default true), "verify"}: owner is the owner's prompt, other another participant's, wake a wake turn's note (no author), shell the owner's stored `!` line (no turn; ParticipantView drops it, so the page never has it). "expected": revisable; "reason": the server's refusal when it isn't.

cases.name: an older own answer with only their own turns after it (D1)
an owner `!` line after it counts for nothing
their own, then someone else's later
